root_cause_summary.physical_trigger: Lube-oil cooler tube leak allowed cooling water to ingress into the pressurized lube oil circulation system (1,800 ppm vs normal <500 ppm).
root_cause_summary.damage_mechanism: Water contamination degraded hydrodynamic oil film strength, inducing metal-to-metal contact wear on babbitt journal bearings and shaft radial vibration escalation.
root_cause_summary.systemic_latent_root_cause: Absence of online water-in-oil DCS monitoring instrumentation allowed moisture ingress to remain undetected until high mechanical vibration occurred.

immediate_actions.action: Execute controlled shutdown / rate reduction on compressor KO-3201 to prevent babbitt journal bearing wipe-out escalation.
Isolate affected compression train and maintain stability across downstream olefin fractionation units.
Replace DE journal bearing sleeve, perform full lube oil system flush, and plug leaking cooler tubes.

permanent_capa.action: Plug and retest leaking lube-oil cooler tubes
Install online water-in-oil transmitter to DCS on KO-3201 lube oil system
Retube lube-oil cooler during next turnaround (TA)
Tighten KO-3201 vibration alarm to 45 µm and shorten trend review intervals
Add cooler dP and conductivity trends to reliability dashboard

HE-3301.process_chain: Cracking Furnace Effluent -> Quench Oil Tower -> HE-3301 Exchanger -> Primary Fractionator

Feed Heavy-ends Content
Cold Outlet Temp
Heat Duty

root_cause_summary.physical_trigger: Feed heavy-ends content exceeded process design limits (2.4% vs design <1.5%), driving coke and polymer fouling along heat exchanger tubes.
root_cause_summary.damage_mechanism: Coke and polymer fouling accumulation drastically reduces heat transfer coefficients and constricts tube flow area, multiplying tube differential pressure (dP).
root_cause_summary.systemic_latent_root_cause: Previous heat exchanger cleaning adhered to a calendar-based interval without integrating real-time condition-based fouling factor indicators.

immediate_actions.action: Reduce unit feed rate or transfer thermal load to standby exchanger / alternate train if available.
Partially open HE-3301 bypass valve to stabilize differential pressure (dP).
Inject chemical antifoulant / dispersing agent per operational SOP.

root_cause_summary.physical_trigger: Feed supply from storage tank was abruptly interrupted during tank switching operation.
root_cause_summary.damage_mechanism: Dry run operation triggered frictional temperature spikes across mechanical seal faces, causing thermal degradation and hydrocarbon leakage.
root_cause_summary.systemic_latent_root_cause: Absence of automatic minimum suction flow trip interlock in DCS allowed pump to run dry, damaging mechanical seal faces.

immediate_actions.action: Cease PU-2101B pump operation and transfer feed charge flow to standby pump PU-2101A.
Isolate suction and discharge valves on PU-2101B and apply LOTO warning tags.
Disassemble seal housing and replace mechanical seal with an inspected standby assembly.

permanent_capa.action: Install suction flow transmitter and integrate automatic low-flow trip interlock into DCS
Update feed tank switching SOP to require dual-operator line lineup confirmation

root_cause_summary.physical_trigger: 12-month fixed lubrication interval was inadequate for continuous full-load operating hours in a dusty industrial environment.
root_cause_summary.damage_mechanism: Grease viscosity breakdown triggered metal-to-metal contact in motor bearings, leading to raceway spalling and elevated vibration.
root_cause_summary.systemic_latent_root_cause: Rigid calendar-based maintenance strategy lacked ultrasonic acoustic inspection validation for grease condition.

immediate_actions.action: Start standby cooling water pump PM-4405A and verify header pressure stability.
Execute controlled shutdown of motor PM-4405B and rack out feeder circuit breaker.
Replace drive-end motor bearing and clean degraded grease.

permanent_capa.action: Transition critical motor lubrication from fixed calendar intervals to condition-based ultrasound acoustic monitoring
Install online PT100 bearing metal temperature sensors wired directly to DCS I/O racks

monitored_variables.name: Overall Vibration
Motor Current
Bearing Temp

root_cause_summary.physical_trigger: Shaft centerline misalignment between drive motor and blower following previous emergency turnaround.
root_cause_summary.damage_mechanism: Shaft coupling misalignment generates cyclic 2X RPM radial forces, fatiguing flexible coupling elements and driving high radial vibration.
root_cause_summary.systemic_latent_root_cause: Previous mechanical alignment relied solely on mechanical dial gauges without thermal growth offset compensation or laser verification.

immediate_actions.action: Reduce BL-5702 blower rotational speed to suppress destructive impeller vibration resonance.
Execute planned blower shutdown and isolate suction/discharge dampers.
Perform shaft realignment using precision laser optical instruments with thermal growth offset.

permanent_capa.action: Mandate precision laser alignment tolerance sheet (<0.05 mm) before issuing operational handover permit
Install continuous wireless vibration sensors with online FFT spectrum analysis on predictive dashboard
